5965.title: Docs edited-block serializers add avoidable Markdown syntax
5965.rootCauseOneLine: Docs delegates edited blocks to default serializers that escape every tilde, autolink URL labels, and write hard breaks as backslash-newline.

prReviews.verdict: Static diff addresses the serializer boundary; draft PR code was not executed.

5965.proposedFix: Override only Docs text/link/hard-break serialization, retain required escapes and explicit links where linkification is unsafe, and round-trip intentional breaks. Existing open draft PR #5968 already links this issue; no duplicate branch was pushed.
5965.caveats: Serializer-level reproduction, not a live browser or on-disk autosave reproduction. Ordinary Enter keyboard behavior was not tested. The same agent repeated both clean runs. An unrelated local candidate passed 127 Docs tests but was stopped when the linked PR appeared.
